title: YAWR Conformance Test Vector Schema
description: Validates every file in design/yawr/conformance/tv-*.yaml. This schema IS the contract between the corpus author (Tess) and Phase 2 implementers (Go parser, C# parser). Any vector that does not validate against this schema MUST NOT be executed by a conformance harness. See spec/grammar/gxl.ebnf §6 for error code definitions.

vectors.description: Ordered list of test vectors. IDs must be globally unique and sequential within their file.

TestVector.description: A single, deterministic, self-contained test case. Every field is normative. 'note' is non-normative.

id.description: Globally unique test vector identifier. Pattern: TV-<LANG>-<GROUP>(-<SUBGROUP>)*-<NNN>. Examples: TV-GXL-PARSE-001, TV-GIS-INTERP-042, TV-GCP-RESOLVE-007. Numeric suffix is zero-padded to ≥3 digits and sequential within its file.

category.description: Coverage category from Barbara's Phase 1 plan §3 (barbara-gxl-phase1-plan.md). Each category maps to a distinct runtime concern. GXL-FUNC is a Tess proposal (see .squad/decisions/inbox/tess-stream-c-day1-schema-and-parse.md) — Barbara must ratify before Phase 2.

description.description: One sentence (≤200 chars) stating exactly what invariant this vector pins down. No vague phrases like 'tests parsing'. Be specific: 'Parser accepts a float literal with negative exponent (scientific notation).'

input.description: The raw expression, template, or path string under test — exactly as it would appear in the relevant YAML runbook field (after YAML decoding but before GXL/GIS/GCP parsing). Must be deterministic: no timestamps, env vars, randomness.

variables.description: The variable context map supplied to the evaluator. JSON value model only: null, boolean, number, string, array, object. No special types (no date, no binary). For parse-only vectors where evaluation is not performed, use {} (empty object). Keys must be valid GXL identifiers (ASCII, not a keyword).

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON-model value: null, boolean, number (IEEE 754 double, finite), string (UTF-8), array, or object. NaN and Infinity are forbidden.

expected.description: The normative outcome of this vector. EITHER a success result (value) OR a failure result (error_class + error_code). These two shapes are mutually exclusive — a vector cannot be both a success and a failure.

note.description: Non-normative. Explanation for human readers (contributors, reviewers). Does NOT affect vector semantics. Use for: citing grammar section, explaining edge case rationale, referencing a related open issue.

tags.description: Machine-readable labels for coverage filtering. Examples: 'short-circuit', 'unicode', 'negative-zero', 'OQ1', 'OQ2'. Used by harness --filter flag.

SuccessExpected.description: The input must parse/evaluate successfully and produce the given value or satisfy a deterministic assertion. For TV-GXL-PARSE vectors, value MUST be the string 'parse_ok' (AST shape is implementation-defined). For non-deterministic results, type/assert/pattern pins the contract without requiring exact equality.

value.description: The expected result. 'parse_ok' for parse-only vectors. Any JSON value for evaluation vectors.

type.description: Expected PJVM type when the vector uses an assertion instead of exact equality.

assert.description: Assertion kind applied by the conformance harness to the produced value.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern used when assert is 'regex'.

ErrorExpected.description: The input must fail with exactly this error class and error code. error_class is the family prefix (e.g., 'GXL-PARSE'). error_code is the specific code (e.g., 'GXL-PARSE-007'). Both MUST match an error declared in the corresponding grammar file (gxl.ebnf §6, gis.ebnf §5, gcp.ebnf §5). If the grammar is silent, use error_code 'TBD' and set note: 'expected_status: undecided'.

error_class.description: Error family prefix. Must be one of: GXL-PARSE, GXL-TYPE, GXL-PATH, GXL-EVAL, GIS-PARSE, GIS-PATH, GIS-TYPE, GIS-EVAL, GCP-PARSE, GCP-RESOLVE, GCP-DEFAULT, GCP-TYPE, GCP-EVAL.

error_code.description: The precise error code from the grammar's error catalog (§6). Pattern: <CLASS>-<NNN>, special catalog symbols such as GIS-PATH-MISSING or GCP-DEFAULT-SUBTREE, or 'TBD' for undecided vectors requiring Barbara arbitration. Examples: 'GXL-PARSE-007', 'GXL-TYPE-001', 'GIS-PATH-MISSING', 'GCP-RESOLVE-004'.

timing.description: Normative phase at which the error is raised when a vector needs parse/eval timing parity.

JsonValue.description: Any value in the YAWR Portable JSON Value Model (OQ3 — see gis.ebnf §PJVM): null, boolean, number (finite IEEE 754 double), string (UTF-8), array of JSON values, or object with string keys and JSON values. NaN and Infinity are explicitly excluded.
